description: Count the business days (Monday to Friday, optionally skipping US federal holidays) between two dates. Use it for working-day questions such as notice periods, delivery windows, payroll runs and project lead times. Use add_business_days instead to find the date that is N business days from a start date, and days_between_dates for plain calendar days. Holidays are the 11 US federal holidays with their observed dates when one falls on a weekend; company and state holidays are not included. Valid for years 2000 to 2100.

end_date.description: The second date; if it is before start_date the two are swapped as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

include_end_date.description: Whether the end date itself is counted when it is a business day. Default true.

skip_us_federal_holidays.description: Whether US federal holidays are left out of the business-day count. Default true.

start_date.description: The first date as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

name: business_days_between

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Business days between two dates
